paragraphs.text: Active exploitation of critical vulnerabilities in widely used platforms and supply chain compromises demand immediate review of vulnerability management, third-party risk, and detection controls. Drupal core exploits, CISA KEV additions including Mitel MiCollab, SAP security incident, and trojanized software downloads indicate systemic exposure across web applications, communication systems, and endpoint utilities. AI-assisted intrusions against critical infrastructure further challenge monitoring assumptions.

Microsoft's planned removal of the WSUS server role in Windows Server 2028 requires change management owners to validate patch delivery alternatives and update approval workflows well before the release.
